# Copilot Instructions

The instructions for this repository live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the
repository root, so that Copilot, Codex, Claude and every other coding agent work from
the same source.

Copilot reads `AGENTS.md` natively. This file exists only as a pointer.

**When a rule changes, edit `AGENTS.md`. Do not copy content into this file.**
